glosses: blues (a musical genre of African American origin)

examples.text: Vamos tocar um pouco de blues.
Tom é o vocalista principal de uma banda de blues.
examples.en: Tom is the lead singer in a blues band.

examples.text: O cantor e guitarrista de Blues Robert Johnson, faria 100 anos de idade no dia 8 de Maio de 2011 se não tivesse morrido aos 27.
examples.en: Blues singer and guitarist Robert Johnson would have been 100 years old on May 8th of 2011 if he hadn't died when he was 27 years old.
